name: Orosil Smiths India Limited
summary: Orosil Smiths India Limited specializes in the creation and distribution of jewelry crafted from silver, gold, and unadorned metals. Through its distinct brands, Kuhjoul and Sincere, the company offers pieces featuring both precious and semi-precious gemstones set in gold and silver. Its diverse product range includes rings, earrings, pendants, anklets, bracelets, bangles, chains, and necklaces. The firm was established on June 1, 1994, and its main office is located in Noida, India.
